title: Make service-invoked System Application facades callable by any user (Privacy Notice + Page Summary Provider)
summary: Two System Application facade codeunits now declare inherent entitlements and permissions so any authenticated user can call them in low-permission sessions like web services, OData, Copilot, and agents, instead of requiring explicit Execute permission.
key_points: Privacy Notice and Page Summary Provider facades previously blocked non-SUPER users with NavPermissionException
Root cause was facades missing InherentEntitlements and InherentPermissions declarations that their implementation codeunits had
Adding inherent grants aligns facades with their delegate implementations and allows Copilot capabilities and agent tasks to function for all users
Actual table access remains controlled by implementation codeunits' declared tabledata permissions
Fixes permission denial for Entra tenant admins and other low-permission session users
quote: This makes them callable by any authenticated user by declaring the inherent grants, matching their impls.
